news.headline: Ventures Platform goes bigger — and broader — with its second Africa fund
news.summary: Pan-African venture firm Ventures Platform closed its second fund at $84M, signaling confidence in the continent's startup ecosystem. The capital will fuel investments across Africa—extending well beyond Nigeria, where the firm got its start, and backing founders tackling continental challenges.

news.headline: China's short-drama producers flood the market with cheap bets — and let audiences pick the winners
news.summary: China's short-drama producers are flooding the market with low-cost content, betting on audience preference to separate hits from misses. The model disrupts traditional entertainment but faces headwinds: mounting distribution costs and the struggle to keep viewers engaged long-term.

educational.title: Bull Market vs. Bear Market — What the Terms Actually Mean
points: A bull market is a sustained rise in prices; a bear market is a sustained fall
The common threshold: a 20%+ drop from a recent high defines a bear market
Bull markets historically last far longer than bear markets on average
Investor psychology often overshoots in both directions — greed, then fear
Long-term investors are taught to expect both phases, not just the good one
